label: Kpower
description: Adds a virtual power meter to your Karoo, estimating power from a physics model when you don't have a real power meter.
releaseNotes: Big update — your estimated power changes a bit (more accurate physics + rolling resistance that adapts to the surface). What's new: several bikes auto-linked to your Karoo ride profiles; record a real ANT+ power meter with full Cycling Dynamics the Karoo can't log itself (L/R balance, torque effectiveness, pedal smoothness, power phase); and optional field calibration that measures your bike's Crr/CdA from a meter ride. Your existing setup keeps working — just review your bike's values. Coming from a version older than 1.9.5? Uninstall the old one first.
